# gambitR ![gambitR logo](reference/figures/logo.png)

A self-contained chess toolkit in native R: legal move generation,
FEN/PGN I/O, position evaluation and alpha-beta search, batch
simulation, an opening explorer, a puzzle trainer, and an interactive
Shiny study app. An optional UCI hook (e.g. Stockfish) enables deeper
analysis.

## Why gambitR?

`gambitR` combines native R move generation with play, simulation, an
opening explorer, a puzzle trainer, and an interactive study app. Move
generation does not require an external chess engine; UCI analysis is
optional.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("r-heller/gambitR")
```

## Quick start

``` r

library(gambitR)

pos <- gm_position()
gm_legal_moves(pos)
gm_plot_board(pos)

# Read a game and replay it
game <- gm_read_pgn("1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 *", text = TRUE)
gm_identify_opening(game)

# Evaluate and search
gm_evaluate(pos)
gm_bestmove(pos, depth = 2)

# Play the native engine against a random mover, then batch it
gm_play(white = "engine", black = "random")
gm_simulate(white = "random", black = "random", n = 20)

# Train on the bundled puzzles
puzzle <- gm_puzzle(seed = 1)
gm_check_solution(puzzle, puzzle$solution)

# Launch the interactive app
gm_run_app()
```

## Correctness

Move generation is verified against the published
[perft](https://www.chessprogramming.org/Perft) reference counts, with
regression checks for castling rights, en passant, pinned pieces and
promotion. These reference positions do not constitute an exhaustive
proof:

| Position       | Depth 1 | Depth 2 | Depth 3 | Depth 4 |
|----------------|--------:|--------:|--------:|--------:|
| Start position |      20 |     400 |   8,902 | 197,281 |
| Kiwipete       |      48 |   2,039 |  97,862 |         |
| Position 3     |      14 |     191 |   2,812 |  43,238 |
| Position 4     |       6 |     264 |   9,467 | 422,333 |
| Position 5     |      44 |   1,486 |  62,379 |         |

These run as part of the test suite; depths 1 and 2 run everywhere,
deeper counts are skipped on CRAN for time.

See [MAINTENANCE.md](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/MAINTENANCE.md)
for the 30 October 2026 repairs, exact local installation path,
verification results and remaining release limits.

# Package index

## Core

- [`gm_position()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_position.md)
  : Create a chess position
- [`is_gm_position()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/is_gm_position.md)
  : Test whether an object is a chess position
- [`gm_read_fen()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_read_fen.md)
  : Read a position from 'FEN'
- [`gm_write_fen()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_write_fen.md)
  : Write a position to 'FEN'
- [`gm_legal_moves()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_legal_moves.md)
  : Generate legal moves
- [`gm_move()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_move.md)
  : Apply a move to a position
- [`gm_status()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_status.md)
  : Position status
- [`gm_game`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_game.md) :
  Chess games
- [`is_gm_game()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/is_gm_game.md)
  : Test whether an object is a chess game

## Analysis

- [`gm_evaluate()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_evaluate.md)
  : Evaluate a position
- [`gm_bestmove()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_bestmove.md)
  : Search for the best move
- [`gm_uci_bestmove()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_uci_bestmove.md)
  : Query a 'UCI' engine for the best move

## Play & Simulation

- [`gm_play()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_play.md)
  : Play a full game between two strategies
- [`gm_simulate()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_simulate.md)
  : Simulate many games between strategies

## Openings & Puzzles

- [`gm_openings()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_openings.md)
  : Look up openings by name or moves
- [`gm_identify_opening()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_identify_opening.md)
  : Identify the opening of a game
- [`gm_puzzle()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_puzzle.md)
  : Load a tactical puzzle
- [`gm_check_solution()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_check_solution.md)
  : Check a puzzle solution attempt

## Visualization

- [`gm_plot_board()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_plot_board.md)
  : Plot a chess board
- [`gm_plot_eval()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_plot_eval.md)
  : Plot an evaluation curve

## I/O

- [`gm_read_pgn()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_read_pgn.md)
  : Read a game from 'PGN'
- [`gm_write_pgn()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_write_pgn.md)
  : Write a game to 'PGN'

## Shiny

- [`gm_run_app()`](https://r-heller.github.io/gambitR/reference/gm_run_app.md)
  : Launch the gambitR Shiny application
